name: LuaJIT built with LUAJIT_SECURITY_MCODE=0: the machine-code area is RWX for its whole lifetime and mcode_protect is a no-op
required_postconditions: MCPROT_GEN == MCPROT_RUN == MCPROT_RWX, so the area is writable and executable simultaneously and forever
mcode_protect(J, prot) is compiled to an empty function, so there is no point at which the JIT could be asked to flip permissions
mcode_setprot is likewise compiled out under LUAJIT_SECURITY_MCODE == 0

failure_sink.description: same sink as the default build: lj_trace_err(J, LJ_TRERR_MCODEAL) aborts the trace and the interpreter continues. A host that refuses PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC makes mmap fail, which this path reports as a failed trace rather than as a configuration error.

source_locations.symbol: comment: 'It's generally considered to be a potential security risk to have pages with simultaneous write *and* execute access in a process.'

extraction_limitations: this is a non-default build configuration; LUAJIT_SECURITY_MCODE defaults to non-zero. It is included because it is the same source file describing a materially different VM contract under one -D flag.

x_campaign.rationale: The probe measured write_execute_simultaneous=true on this host, so RWX anonymous memory is obtainable; a W^X-enforcing host is where this would break.
